title: Claims of the Firebase ID token the backend relies on (interface: token verification, SR-01)
description: The backend verifies signature (Google's published keys), issuer, audience and expiry, then reads only these claims. Membership and role are never read from the token (security-requirements.md). The Authentication Emulator issues the same claims in an unsigned token, accepted only when FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST is set.

sub.description: Firebase user id (User.id). A user id in deleted_accounts is refused with 401 (R-016-06).

auth_time.description: Time of the last sign-in, seconds; an account deletion needs it within 5 minutes (R-016-07).

email_verified.description: False gives 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED on every endpoint except /health (R-017-03, BR-03).

name.description: Display name. Empty or missing: the part of the e-mail before the at sign; longer than 100 characters: cut to 100 (D-20).
